title: Are LLM Preferences Transitive Enough for a Utility Function? Measuring VNM-Violation Rates

original_idea.body:
# Measuring VNM-Violation Rates

Elicit pairwise choices, build preference graph, measure intransitivity and utility-fit degradation.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to RLHF/reward-modeling foundations but the step to a concrete catastrophe is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pairwise-choice elicitation and graph cycle analysis; inference-only, accessible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Transitivity/consistency failures documented; the VNM-violation-vs-utility-fit angle may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Consistency benchmarks exist; the utility-fit-degradation framing may be open.
